name: What are the signs of a main sewer line clog?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of a main sewer line clog?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several signs indicate a potential main sewer line clog. The most common is multiple drains in your home backing up simultaneously, such as a toilet overflowing when the shower is running. Gurgling sounds from toilets or drains, especially when water is used elsewhere in the house, are also a strong indicator. Foul sewage odors emanating from drains can signal a blockage. If sewage is backing up into your shower, tub, or toilet, it's a clear sign of a significant obstruction in the main line. Slow draining from all fixtures can also point to a problem.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs of a main sewer line clog include multiple drains backing up, gurgling sounds from drains, sewage odors, and sewage backing up into fixtures.
